name: Improvised Maula Pistol
description: Lightweight but with a short range, the Maula Pistol is a reliable sidearm.

name: Ari's Pistol
description: A special Maula Pistol that greatly increases accuracy while Prescient.

name: Unfixed Crysknife
description: The Unfixed Crysknife is made from a sandworm's tooth and is very brittle. Cannot leave the owner's person.

name: Zantara's Crysknife
description: A Special crysknife that used to belong to Zantara.

name: Feyd’s Spare Blades
description: Feyd-Rautha is known to favor his own custom sets of Kindjal and Slip-tip dual blades, making deadly use of their combination. It would be a rare privileged to own such a set. How many lives have these razor edges claimed?

name: The Glutton's Hook
description: A Special sharpened hook that's been used on all manner of meats. Adds bleed stacks to its target on hit.

name: Asterion’s End
description:
A dense, razor-edged <Unique>Unique</> weapon built to shear through armored flesh by force alone.

Tauromachy, the brutal Old Terran contest of man against beast, endured as a defining Atreides rite until Old Duke Paulus fell beneath Salusan horns. Asterion’s End lingers as a ghost of the arena, whispered as though the Minotaur’s curse still coils within it, binding valor and doom in equal measure.

name: Scrap Metal Knife
description: Designed by necessity using whatever is close at hand, many resort to this melee weapon for short-range Blade Damage.

name: Feyd's Take-Down Blade
description: A Special assassination blade that quickly poisons its target.

name: The Angry Adder
description: Sometimes, even a minor wound can kill. This <Unique>Unique</> rifle is modified to do poison damage.

name: Hell-Fury Pistol
description: A special cocktail of magnesium and certain other elements can produce a very nasty, burning round. This <Unique>Unique</> snub-nosed heavy pistol causes fire-buildup on a hit.

name: The Hateful Barker
description: Peak aggression is often the enemy of precision. This <Unique>Unique</> LMG is very inaccurate but makes up for it with a 25% damage bonus.

name: Spitting Cobra
description: If at first your poison fails to slay — inundate, inundate, inundate. This <Unique>Unique</>, assassin-modified disruptor causes poison buildup with every hit.

name: Blind Fury
description: Necessity is the mother of modification. This <Unique>Unique</> rifle sacrifices its scope for slightly faster reload, slightly faster rate of fire, and holds 5 ammo.

name: Eel’s Tooth
description: The best offense is a fully-charged battery. Every attack from this <Unique>Unique</> blade restores one’s battery pack by 5.

name: Leech’s Maw
description: A drained enemy is a helpless enemy. Every hit from these <Unique>Unique</> dual blades drains a target of power.

name: Serpent’s Fang
description: Intrigue amongst the Great Houses is a treacherous game. Poison often coats the blades of polite society. This <Unique>Unique</> Kindjal causes poison damage.

name: Prescient Edge
description: The edge of this blade is so sharp, its balance so precise, the wielder feels as if they know their opponent’s next move before they do. No attacker comes away unscathed. This <Unique>Unique</> rapier causes bleed on an opponent with every successful parry.

name: Branding Blade
description: A special chemical treatment super heats the blade. Enemies who live tend to carry the scars with them forever after. This <Unique>Unique</> sword causes burn buildup with every hit.
